At the end of Maple Row, there is a quaint little shop called "Whispers of Yore." Inside, the air is thick with the scent of old paper, leather, and spices from faraway lands.

The shop's shelves are lined with an eclectic mix of artifacts, from ancient coins and medieval manuscripts to peculiar items like an ornate, hand-carved chess set or a set of tiny, porcelain dolls dressed in period-appropriate attire.
